title: Home-first startup and setting/location organized map library
selected_by_owner: Owner reviewed MMHT-UX-01 on Android and directed a central startup screen every launch, easier map opening, exclusion of poorly rendered earlier demonstrations from everyday browsing, and grouping by setting, location/collection and map type; owner explicitly said Continue (2026-11-20).

in_scope: Launch the cumulative standalone tester to an explicit fixed Home screen, even with a previously active saved map, without rewriting or clearing saved workspace state.

Replace everyday flat example-heavy map opening with a searchable organization hierarchy: setting → collection/location → filtered maps; per-map type tags, recency sorting, favorites and limited paginated results.

Create settings; assign existing or new maps to settings/locations; provide explicit My maps, four current sample copies, and separate older/legacy and manually archived map views. No destructive cleanup.

Preserve underlying legacy editor and all existing Cycle01–15 tools and schemas; reroute the old Open maps header action to the organized library; import original editable JSON drafts and allow example copies.

Repair native saved-workspace restoration when pre-initialization calls to advanced spatial validators caused otherwise valid saved documents to be rejected; guard only those checks using their existing READY flags.
Deliver a completely self-contained browser HTML file, documented source, user guide, four current editable sample drafts, desktop/mobile screenshots, checksums and browser tests.
boundaries: Organization index is a localStorage sidecar; setting/collection changes do not mutate map geometry, IDs, gameplay links or map draft schema.
Older examples are hidden from the default library, not deleted or automatically certified as broken; archive and recovery remain available.

Library organization backup contains categorization metadata only, not full map documents. Full editable drafts require their own exports. Across different Android content:// origins/files, saved-device data may not be shared.

Chromium set_content with controlled localStorage across fresh browser pages is not a physical Android content:// acceptance test, actual cross-file migration, production entitlements or installed Unity integration.

evidence.validation: Node --check accepted the combined native/editor/studio/library JavaScript. Chromium Playwright set_content: 1280x900 desktop and 390x844 mobile-like viewports had zero pageerrors and no horizontal overflow. Explicit Home start, user-created map under Havalaea/Western Canopy, rediscovery by setting and text search, favorite, Home after saved-workspace reload, native-header Open maps rerouting, current/legacy separation, editable example duplication, non-destructive archive/restore, true Cycle15 regional draft import with identical bundled-source personal-copy behavior, and downloaded JSON organization metadata backup passed. A native reload regression was reproduced (15 map documents rejected early with generic error); guarding MMHT14 and MMHT15 validators by READY flags preserved 46-document saved-workspace reload. Browser network/file navigation blocked by harness, so synthetic localStorage persisted between fresh Playwright pages via a controlled polyfill; physical Android device and actual content:// storage behavior remain unverified.
source_references: Owner Android Chrome screenshots of MMHT-11 and MMHT-15 and follow-up user report of confusing library/startup
Previous MMHT-UX-01 cumulative standalone HTML, original MMHT-15 code

next_action: Owner reviews the new Home and grouped My Maps interface in actual Android Chrome using a previously saved workspace, and checks content:// storage scope. Any further UX remediation or app integration requires separate owner direction.
successor_rule: UX-02 is owner-directed remediation after the final MMHT-15 content cycle; do not auto-create a new content cycle.

last_material_progress.evidence: Self-contained UX-02 HTML, grouped library, central startup, 4 curated sample drafts, 20-file ZIP and regression tests including restored local workspace.

stop_reason.evidence: Bounded owner-directed browser-only UX-02 workbench delivered and tested. Physical Android content:// and installed app remain external acceptance.
